verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents tool/function calling, where the model requests functions the application defines (cerebras-docs-7). It also offers JSON-schema-constrained Structured Outputs (cerebras-docs-6) and OpenAI API compatibility (cerebras-docs-3), which together support the core of agent tool use. The evidence does not show parallel tool calls, multi-step loops, or any independent check that tool calling stays reliable on the hosted open models. missing for 10: documented parallel tool calls, multi-step/agent-loop tool use, per-model tool-calling support, hands-on or independent corroboration of reliability.
